notes: Stories validated; no duplicates; aligned to schema/core/API/tests/integration split.

stories.title: Define Relevance Scoring Schema and Contract
stories.description: Create Pydantic schema defining inputs (user query intent, normalized condition terms, eligibility signals) and outputs (relevance score, match rationale, eligibility flags). Ensure compatibility with existing clinical trials tool models.

stories.title: Implement Condition and Eligibility Matching Logic
stories.description: Build core logic to compare user query intent against trial condition fields and eligibility criteria text, including normalization (synonyms, casing) and lightweight inclusion/exclusion parsing with deterministic scoring heuristics.

stories.title: Expose Relevance Signals via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate relevance scoring into clinical trials search orchestration and expose structured fields (score, matched condition, eligibility fit, rationale) through evaluate_care_facade without breaking existing response contracts.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Relevance Matching and Scoring
stories.description: Create unit tests covering condition normalization, synonym handling, eligibility inclusion/exclusion parsing, and scoring outputs across scenarios (exact, partial, mismatch, missing data).

stories.title: End-to-End Integration with Clinical Trials Search Flow
stories.description: Validate integration with ClinicalTrials.gov search ensuring each trial result includes relevance metadata and that formatting, ordering, and existing fields remain intact.
